definitions.explanation: The text produced by translating: the translation as a piece of writing, set against the original.

examples.japanese: {訳文|やくぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{原文|げんぶん}→原文：20563_genbun⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{訳文|やくぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比|くら}べる→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧。
examples.english: To compare the original with the translation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{訳文|やくぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧で、⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}えない→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: This translation is so natural that you wouldn't think it was translated.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧: translation as an activity, and the everyday word for a translation
- ⟦{原文|げんぶん}→原文：20563_genbun⟧: the original text
- ⟦{和訳|わやく}→和訳：17845_wayaku⟧ / ⟦{英訳|えいやく}→英訳：16317_eiyaku⟧: translation into Japanese / into English

WATCH OUT:
⟦{約分|やくぶん}→約分：30690_yakubun⟧ (reducing a fraction) has the same reading.
